
The following figures present the annual exceedance probability for $S_a(T_n)$ for different structural periods and confidence intervals for the actual geotechnical conditions of the site, estimated as firm soil with an average shear wave velocity of the top 30 meters, $v_S^30\approx880 \text{m/s}$.

::: {.content-hidden when-format="html"}


```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| fig-cap: "Annual Exceedence Probabilities (AEP) - PGA" 
#| label: fig-AEP_docx

FILE <- file.path("png/AEP_pga.png")
knitr::include_graphics(path=FILE, dpi = DPI)

```

:::

::: {.panel-tabset .nav-pills .content-visible when-format="html" unless-format="revealjs"}
### Tn=0 (PGA, all quantiles)

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| fig-cap: "Annual Exceedence Probabilities (AEP) - PGA Sa(Tn==0)" 
#| label: fig-AEP_pga

TR_max <- 100000
p_TARGET <- AEPTable$p |> unique()
DATA <- AEPTable[p%in% p_TARGET & Tn==0 & TR<=TR_max,.(ID=p,X=Sa,Y=AEP)][order(X)]|> unique()

PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "hc",
  plot.theme=highcharter::hc_theme_flat(),
  xAxis.label =TRUE,
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  legend.layout="vertical",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  line.size=2.0,
  xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.legend="AEP [1/yr]",
  xAxis.legend="PGA [g]",
  group.legend="quantile",
  plot.save=FALSE,
  plot.title="Annual Exceedence Probabilities (AEP) - PGA",
  data=DATA) 
PLOT

# Export PLOT for .docx rendering
FILE <- file.path("png/AEP_pga.png")
DPI <- 150
WIDTH <- round(FACTOR_WIDTH * PAGE_WIDTH * DPI)
HEIGHT <- round(FACTOR_HEIGHT * PAGE_HEIGHT * DPI)
buildPlot::export(hc=PLOT, filename=FILE,width=WIDTH,height=HEIGHT,dpi=DPI,delay=DELAY)
# 

```
### Sa(Tn), p=mean

```{r echo=FALSE,include=TRUE}
#| fig-cap: "Annual Exceedence Probabilities (AEP)" 
#| label: fig-AEP_mean
#| column: body-outset-right

p_TARGET <- "mean"
TR_max <- 100000
DATA <- AEPTable[ p %in% p_TARGET & Tn>=0 & TR<=TR_max,.(ID=Tn,X=Sa,Y=AEP)]|> unique()
setorder(DATA,X)
PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "hc",
  xAxis.label =TRUE,
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  legend.layout="vertical",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  line.size=2.0,
  xAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.log = TRUE,
  yAxis.legend="AEP [1/yr]",
  xAxis.legend="PGA [g]",
  group.legend="Tn [s]",
  data=DATA)
PLOT
```
